_rascunho: Draft translation of the Portuguese text (pt.json is the final one).
chamada: Write together, annotate the archive, make posters and zines. Posters and zines are made on this device: none of the artwork goes to the server.

erros.generico: That didn't work. Try again in a moment.
erros.desligado: Making together is switched off right now.
erros.nao_encontrado: We couldn't find that. It may have been deleted.
erros.conflito: The text changed while you were reading. Open it again and try once more.
erros.invalido:trecho: That passage is no longer in the text (or appears more than once). Pick another one.
erros.invalido:proposta: The replacement is the same as the passage. Write something else.
erros.invalido:titulo: The title needs letters or numbers.
erros.invalido:corpo: The text would end up empty or too long.
erros.invalido:muitas: This page has reached its limit.
erros.invalido:muitos: A zine takes up to 12 posts.
erros.invalido:contraste: Text on the background needs a contrast of 4.5 or more.
erros.invalido:fonte: Choose one of the fonts on the list.
erros.invalido:assinatura: The signature has no link and up to 80 characters.
erros.dado_pessoal: That looks like a CPF. Don't put personal data here.
erros.ja_existe: There is already a page with that title.
erros.nao_e_rascunho: This page is not a draft.
erros.muitos_pedidos: Too many requests in a row. Wait a little.

margem.nenhumaComunidade: You are not in any community yet. Drafts and the margin are only for people in the community.
margem.quemVe: Only people in this community see the notes, suggestions and replies. Nobody, not even moderators, sees who wrote each one.
margem.nucleo: In a local group, the server doesn't know who belongs to it: a margin just for the group belongs in the group's encrypted chat.
margem.soQuemEdita: Drafts are started by people who can edit this community's wiki. Anyone in the community can suggest and comment.
margem.semPaginas: This community's wiki has no pages yet.
margem.historico: See the versions in the wiki
margem.selecionar: Select a passage of the text to annotate it or suggest a change.
margem.trechoRepetido: That passage appears more than once in the text. Pick a longer piece.
margem.trechoMudou: The passage changed since the note (made on version {n}).
margem.confirmarFechar: Close the draft? Nobody can suggest anymore, and the wiki page is locked. The text and versions stay in the wiki.
margem.fechadoAviso: Draft closed by the moderators. The text and versions stay in the wiki.

cartaz.texto: Make the poster with your organization's identity. It is drawn on this device and downloaded as an image: none of the artwork goes to the server.
cartaz.semOrg: If you speak for an organization, its identity shows up here. Without one, the poster uses Alumia's colors.
cartaz.cuidado: Don't put a home address or the name of anyone who didn't ask to appear.
cartaz.identidadeTexto: Whoever manages the organization saves the colors, the font and the signature. Text on the background needs a contrast of 4.5 or more.
cartaz.contrasteBaixo: Low contrast: the text is hard to read. It needs 4.5 or more.

zine.texto: Put posts on an A4 sheet that, folded and cut in the middle, becomes an 8-page booklet. The sheet is put together on this device. For a PDF, use Print and choose Save as PDF.
zine.regra: Only your open posts and other people's posts that can already leave Alumia go in. Restricted posts don't, not even yours.
zine.semMeus: You don't have an open post for the zine yet.
zine.codigoRuim: We couldn't find a post code there.
zine.fora: {n} post(s) were left out: they are restricted or can't leave Alumia.
zine.cortados: Some texts were cut to fit the page.
passos: Print the sheet in landscape, on A4, with no margins.
Fold it in half lengthwise and open it.
Fold it in half widthwise, and again.
Open it halfway and cut only the middle crease.
Open it, fold it lengthwise and push the ends to the center.
Close it like a booklet, with the cover outside.
zine.contracapa: Made on Alumia, with no ads and no tracking. Pass it on.
